Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

- Tue 2028-04-25 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2028-04-26 14:00–15:00 PT

- Stratus owns the SI success narrative + customer ops intro (Eliot)
- Kimberly owns calendar invites, attendee gating, and the marketplace checklist handoff

If that works, Kimberly — can you take the invite + gating? I will prepare a trimmed runbook and push a single shared Drive link. I also attached a quick proposed slots .ics for the two windows Priya suggested so folks can pick.

Proposed final slot (if we can converge): Wed 2028-04-26 14:00–15:00 PT — gives Stratus a morning for prep.

Attachments: proposed_slots.ics (Soojin), runbook_v2.pdf (draft)

Thanks — tagging Marissa for partner enablement visibility.
